name: ^applyRunSchema\.safeParse$
reason: zod validates the body against the schema; the twin only follows success and data.

name: ^optionalEnv$
reason: Reads one named environment variable; the twin checks only presence and parses it.

name: ^getHarnessPublicUrl$
reason: Returns the configured public URL; the twin only checks it is set and passes it on.

name: ^Date\.now$
reason: The clock is an input; the twin only subtracts its readings.

name: ^acceptIngress$
reason: Convex admission is an external store; the twin passes on its verdict.

name: ^new (Session|SubagentCoordinator|ReadableStream)$
reason: Constructors whose instance is only handed to later effects.

name: ^controller\.(close|enqueue)$
reason: The web stream sink; the twin checks the exact bytes written.

name: ^event\.channel\.sendText$
reason: The channel adapter; the twin checks the text sent.

name: ^recordFailedTurn$
reason: Telemetry for a failed turn; its result is not used.

name: ^session ?\.(assertCurrentOwner|createTurnContext)$
reason: Session instance methods over stored state; the twin follows the outcome only.

name: SubagentCoordinator
reason: Instance is only passed from its constructor to the continuation loop.

name: Session
reason: Instance is only passed along; the twin reads scalar fields.

name: ReadableStream
reason: Result of the stream constructor, passed along.

name: ReadableStreamDefaultController
reason: The controller handed to start, only written to.

name: ^\$enter:(arg0|arg2|compact|start|onFinalText|onErrorText|onApprovalRequired|onQuestionsPending)$
reason: Callback entries carry only the arguments the caller supplied; the twin checks every effect made inside them.

name: SpanImpl
reason: An OpenTelemetry span held in the run's inputs; the twin does not read it.

name: Tracer
reason: An OpenTelemetry tracer held in the tracker's inputs; the twin does not read it.
